_readme: Per-species photo overrides. Keyed by scientificName (must match column-mapping's speciesMetadataColumns → scientificName column exactly). Each entry may include 'inatQuery' (an alternate iNaturalist search string, e.g. a trinomial for a subspecies) and/or a 'note' explaining why the override exists. When present, fetch-photos.py fetches the override taxon's photo but keeps the species-level taxon_id - so the app still links to the species (not subspecies) page. Adding or changing an override forces a refetch on the next run (no --refresh flag needed).

Aegithalos caudatus.note: iNat default shows the northern nominate form (white head); UK birds are the rosaceus subspecies with a pink-tinged, striped face.
